reserved_subsets.reason: Phase 1-3 evaluation speakers aew/axb plus one ARCTIC speaker of unknown identity (pysptk sample a0007): the whole corpus is excluded

contaminated_evaluators.ge2e_resemblyzer: trained on LibriSpeech and VoxCeleb data according to its project documentation (exact subsets to be re-checked); this overlaps any LibriSpeech/LibriTTS training data, so GE2E is reported but never decisive

_doc_same_speaker_space: LibriVox-derived corpora share LibriVox reader ids (assumption for MLS/Libri-Light/Libriheavy/DNS: verify on download by id overlap + embedding dedup; if wrong, the mapping is only over-conservative)
